full_judgment: 2. This arises from T.S. No. 101 of 1988 of the Court of Senior Assistant Judge, Moulavibazar. In that suit the plaintiffs were seeking declaration that certain Khatians in favour of the defendants were wrong. The defendants contested the suit by filing a written statement in which they claimed the suit land by pattan from the original land lord. According to the plain-tiffs, the deed of pattan is a forged document, which they want to be examined by an expert. The trial court, by an order dated 27 January, 1993, rejected the prayer for expert examination on the ground that it was too late, for, the trial had begun in 1988 but no step was taken by the plaintiffs for getting this document examined by an expert. The learned Single Judge of the High Court Division did not interfere in revision with this order of the trial court.
